name: M & M Strawberry Farm
tagline: Merrill strawberry farms boast bumper crop
description: In Merrill, WI, M & M Strawberry Farm raises Strawberries on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
